Given that $∠Z$ is acute, calculate its measure. **Round** your answer to the **nearest degree**.

$m∠Z≈$
{{field-1}}${}^{∘}$
question.worked_solution:
The Law of Sines states that

$$
\frac{\operatorname{sin}⁡Z}{z}=\frac{\operatorname{sin}⁡Y}{y}.
$$

In this case, we have

$$
m∠Y={57}^{∘},\,y=35,\,z=24
$$

and therefore

$$
\begin{aligned}\frac{\operatorname{sin}⁡Z}{24} & =\frac{\operatorname{sin}⁡{57}^{∘}}{35} \\ \operatorname{sin}⁡Z & =24\cdot \frac{\operatorname{sin}⁡{57}^{∘}}{35} \\  & =\frac{24\cdot \operatorname{sin}⁡{57}^{∘}}{35} \\  & =\frac{24\cdot 0.838…}{35} \\  & ≈0.575,\end{aligned}
$$

rounded to $3$ decimal places.

Therefore,

$$
\begin{aligned}m∠Z & ≈\operatorname{arcsin}⁡(0.575)≈{35}^{∘},\end{aligned}
$$

rounded to the nearest degree.
